description:
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to look at the top card of a player's library and draw a card at the beginning of the next upkeep.
Cast Lotus Petal by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Loran.
When Loran enters the battlefield, it triggers, returing Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast Mishra's Bauble by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Loran.
When Loran enters the battlefield, it triggers, returing Lotus Petal from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
